content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for missing prior auth at time of service. This payer offers no retroactive authorization and no peer-to-peer review. An appeal was already filed and there's no denial currently on the table to appeal again. Prior auth cannot be obtained retroactively, so the missing-auth denial cannot be cured. With no viable path to collect from the payer and patient cannot be billed for a provider auth failure, the balance is uncollectible.","action":"write_off"}
